approach: Repeat the complete 75-run V1 matrix with five independent seeds. Use the validated single-rank Release CPU binary, one OpenMP thread per process, eight concurrent processes, a 3600-second per-run timeout, and a last-96-snapshot stationarity window with a two-standard-deviation reversal threshold.
runtime_basis: V1 observed 7.94 CPU-hours and a 1702.33-second maximum single-run time for the same population, grid, physical duration, output cadence, and matrix. V1B keeps parallel=8 and doubles the timeout margin.
evidence_boundary: V1B may validate numerical resolution and analysis premises for later Cycle 4 experiments. It cannot support the landscape-effect claim itself.
